title: Video model routing adjusted during a provider outage
summary:
A maintenance day: video model routing changed around a provider outage, GSoC guidance was corrected, and the developer tools catalog got a tidy-up.

Imagen 4, Grok Video, and Qwen Character were temporarily removed from the model registries because of a provider outage. Wan 2.6 remains listed, now routing directly through Alibaba DashScope with the `wan2.6-t2v` model ID and marked paid-only.

The README no longer advertises GSoC 2026 applications. The GSoC page now states that Pollinations is not participating this year and points prospective contributors toward regular open-source contributions.

GENEXUS AI, a community-built backend for apps using Pollinations, was added to the Dev_Tools catalog and README app table. InferencePort AI was removed from the README table.
